quadrants.description: Four replicate blocks of 5 real data columns each. This is NOT a uniform period-6 grid, and column membership must never be derived from a modular offset formula (col-1) % N + 1 -- that formula was the source of a real bug (fixed 2026-08-18, see notes.correction_2026-08-18) that mislabelled column 7 as empty in every drug row. The real gap structure is irregular: 1-column edge gaps at the plate's outer columns (1, 24), and a 2-column gap at the plate midline (12, 13). There is NO gap between quadrants 1/2 (columns 6/7 are adjacent, both real data) or between quadrants 3/4 (columns 18/19 are adjacent, both real data). Use quadrants.empty_columns for spacer lookup and quadrants.Q1-Q4[*].columns for an explicit column list per quadrant -- both hardcoded, not formula-derived.

column_pattern_within_quadrant.description: Position (1-5, in left-to-right column order) within a quadrant's 5 real data columns -> concentration tier, high to low. There is no 'position 1 is empty' entry any more -- empty/spacer columns are listed explicitly in quadrants.empty_columns instead of being encoded as the first position of every quadrant.

control_column_pattern_within_quadrant.description: In control rows M and N, positions 1-2 (of a quadrant's 5 real data columns) are Benzethonium Chloride (positive control), positions 3-5 are DMSO (vehicle/negative control). Empty/spacer columns are handled via quadrants.empty_columns, same as drug rows.

Staurosporine.description: Pan-kinase inhibitor; induces broad apoptosis. Used as cytotoxic positive control.

Benzethonium Chloride.description: Cytotoxic detergent. Used as positive control for cell death.

DMSO.description: Vehicle control (solvent used to dissolve drugs). Used as negative/baseline control.

notes.replicates_per_drug: 2 rows per drug × 4 quadrants = 8 wells per concentration per plate
notes.correction_2026-08-18: Prior versions of this file modelled the plate as 4 identical, contiguous 6-column quadrants (Q1=1-6, Q2=7-12, Q3=13-18, Q4=19-24) with column offset 1 always empty within each quadrant, derived via col_offset=(col-1)%6+1. Re-checked directly against the source PDF (docs/layout/MF Plate Layouts_MF5v1.pdf): the real layout has edge gaps at columns 1 and 24 only, plus a 2-column gap at the midline (12-13) -- NOT a repeating empty-then-5 pattern every 6 columns. Column 7 (previously mislabelled 'empty' for every drug row) is actually quadrant 2's first real data column (the highest concentration tier), matching e.g. E07 = Navitoclax 75µM used throughout prior analysis. See docs_local/feature_to_mcherry/note_plate_layout_column_bug.md for the full writeup. This is the sole canonical layout file the code loads. A redundant machine-readable mirror once existed at docs/layout/MF5v1_plate_layout.json (same schema, loaded by no code, hand-synced); it was removed 2026-09-01. The human-readable docs/layout/MF5v1_plate_layout.md and the source docs/layout/MF Plate Layouts_MF5v1.pdf remain.
